title: Past-week digests report today's streak and award achievements from it
body:
## Summary
The digest for a past week carries the current streak and streak achievements as of now, so a week from months ago can show today's figures.

## Description
src/lib/weekly-digest.ts:85-97 reads the newest 200 sessions with no window, and :130-137 feeds that currentStreak into computeAchievements for any weeksAgo. longestStreak (:103-121) likewise includes sessions after the viewed week. The 200-row tail also caps a streak above 200 silently. Fixed means streaks are computed as of the viewed week's end, or are omitted from past weeks. Violates analytics-time-windows: a figure on a windowed report must belong to that window.

## Flow
- Step to a week 10 weeks back in WeeklyDigestView
- generateWeeklyDigest(new Date(win.start), zone) reads the unwindowed tail
- Card, markdown and poster show today's streak; the Unstoppable achievement can appear on a week that earned nothing

## Expected impact
Past-week reviews stop mixing present-day figures into history. A consumer expecting all-time streak on the current week must keep that; the current week is unchanged.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - windowed report contains only that window's figures
Before: 2 unwindowed streak queries feed a windowed digest; achievements use one of them (read from source)
After: predicted 0 unwindowed queries for weeksAgo > 0
Method: simulation - lib/weekly-digest.ts is outside this context's paths, so no change was applied
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/lib/weekly-digest.ts:89 LIMIT 200 (newest-first, no window)
src/lib/weekly-digest.ts:105 ORDER BY completed_at ASC (all history)
src/app/api/weekly-digest/route.ts:26 generateWeeklyDigest(new Date(win.start), zone)
instrument: Seed session_analytics with a failure after week W and a run of successes before it; assert generateWeeklyDigest(W) streak ends at W's end and carries no streak achievement from later rows.

title: Daily spend chart removes idle days and buckets in UTC
body:
## Summary
The daily spend chart has one bar per active day, so idle days vanish and the time axis is uneven; its days are UTC while the digest uses the report zone.

## Description
src/lib/cli-spend-db.ts:285-296 groups by substr(recorded_at,1,10) and LIMITs 30 rows, so 30 bars can span far more than 30 days. src/components/modules/evaluator/SpendDashboard.tsx:136 draws them at equal width, showing no gaps. Budget enforcement is deliberately UTC (ENFORCED_BUDGET_ZONE), so the zone part needs a decision on whether the chart follows budget or report zone. Governing technique: metrics-rollups bucketing-strategy, absent buckets are zeros when the source was observing.

## Flow
- Spend on Mon, then again 20 days later
- Chart shows two adjacent bars
- The reader sees continuous activity

## Expected impact
The trend's x axis becomes real time. BudgetEditPreview replays the same daily array, so it must keep receiving only recorded days or be rechecked.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - chart x axis is calendar time
Before: 3 fixture days 20 apart render 3 adjacent bars (from code path)
After: predicted 41 calendar slots with 38 empty
Method: simulation - the rollup is outside this context and the preview consumer needs its own run
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/lib/cli-spend-db.ts:288 substr(recorded_at,1,10) AS day ... GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT ?
src/lib/cli-spend/budgetPreview.ts:17 ENFORCED_BUDGET_ZONE = 'UTC'
instrument: DailyTrend render test with non-adjacent days asserting one slot per calendar day, plus SpendBudgetPanel.preview tests unchanged.

title: A failed budget load reads as No limit set
body:
## Summary
When the budget fetch fails, the panel shows the empty default and says No limit set, even if limits are configured.

## Description
src/hooks/useCliSpend.ts:71-77 swallows the fetch error and keeps emptyBudgetStatus, whose config has null limits. SpendBudgetPanel then renders No limit set for both meters, and Edit limits seeds empty inputs, so saving from that state clears real limits. Unknown is not none (measurement-honesty). Fixed means useBudget exposes a load error, and the panel shows it and blocks editing until loaded. The hook is outside this context.

## Flow
- GET /api/cli-spend?action=budget fails
- Status stays at the empty default
- Panel reads No limit set; Edit then Save writes null over the stored limits

## Expected impact
A transient failure can no longer erase a configured guard or claim none exists. useBudget has other callers to check.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - unknown budget state is never presented as no limit
Before: 1 catch path maps load failure to the null-limit config (read from source)
After: predicted alert shown and Edit disabled until a successful load
Method: simulation - the required change is in src/hooks/useCliSpend.ts, outside this round's paths
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: Hook test with a rejecting budget fetch asserting a loadError field, plus a panel test asserting Edit limits is disabled and No limit set is absent.

title: Success-rate bands disagree between analytics views
body:
## Summary
The same success rate gets different status colours on different evaluator tabs.

## Description
src/components/modules/evaluator/SessionAnalyticsDashboard/helpers.ts:11 scoreBand and the overview tile cut at 70 and 40. WeeklyDigestView and ProjectWrappedView cut at 0.75 and 0.5 in repeated inline ternaries, and project-wrapped counts a module conquered at 0.7. A 72% module is Good on one tab and amber on another. The canonical cut is a product decision, so it is not built here.

## Flow
- A module has a 72% success rate
- Module Performance shows Good
- Weekly leaderboard and Wrapped show the middle band

## Expected impact
One meaning for a band across tabs and posters, from one function. Choosing 70/40 or 75/50 repaints one set of views.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one band definition
Before: 2 threshold pairs; 17 inline 0.75/0.5 lines in Weekly and Wrapped; 3 cut lines in Session Analytics
After: 1 shared band function, 0 inline cuts
Method: probe - grep over the context's files; the choice of thresholds cannot be measured
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction
evidence:
grep -nE '0\.75|0\.5\b' over WeeklyDigestView and ProjectWrappedView: 17 lines
src/components/modules/evaluator/SessionAnalyticsDashboard/helpers.ts:11 value >= 70
src/lib/project-wrapped.ts:75 m.successRate >= 0.7

title: formatDuration can print 1m 60s and 1h 60m
body:
## Summary
The shared duration formatter rounds the remainder without carrying, so durations just under a unit boundary print an impossible value.

## Description
src/lib/format.ts:47-48 formatDuration floors minutes and separately rounds the seconds remainder: 119 600 ms prints 1m 60s. The hour branch has the same shape (Math.round on the minutes remainder). Session Analytics now uses this formatter, alongside Weekly and Wrapped. Fixed means rounding to the displayed unit before splitting. src/lib/format.ts is outside this context and has app-wide callers.

## Flow
- A session lasts 119.6 s
- formatDuration splits to 1 minute and round(59.6) seconds
- The panel prints 1m 60s

## Expected impact
No impossible durations anywhere the formatter is used; existing format tests must still hold.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - durations are valid at unit boundaries
Before: 119600 ms gives 1m 60s (node evaluation of the expression)
After: 2m 0s
Method: probe - evaluated the arithmetic; not applied because the file is out of scope
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: Unit cases on formatDuration at 119600 ms and 7 199 000 ms asserting no 60 in the lower unit.
